hook: OpenAI is training AI models on creative work, but SAG-AFTRA is fighting back in court.

sections.voiceover: OpenAI is training AI models on creative work, but SAG-AFTRA is fighting back in court.
Can a judge stop OpenAI from using unlicensed content under a broad fair use exemption?
The Writers Guild of America argues this training harms individual professionals rather than just companies.
SAG-AFTRA and other unions filed a 34-page brief detailing how unlicensed training hurts human creators. The American Federation of Musicians joined this legal filing to block OpenAI from using work.
These labor unions now urge a federal judge to reject OpenAI's request for fair use.
